name: Care Instructions
summary: Passive target-owned care guidance presented as a native unordered list with complete visible text, optional decorative icons, homogeneous supporting tone, and zero checklist or acknowledgement state.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named native section when a visible title is supplied; otherwise a generic container. Omitted when the required items composition is absent or empty.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional header emitted only with a visible title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading and section label when supplied.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Native unordered list of related target-owned instructions. The compatibility class .care-instructions__grid may coexist on the same element.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Direct native list item containing one complete passive instruction.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional redundant supporting icon hidden from assistive technology; icon identity remains target presentation.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible instruction that remains complete without icon or color.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored practical detail or qualification with no clamping.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Neutral supporting icon treatment for a passive care set.

variants.name: do
variants.description: Success-family supporting icon treatment for a homogeneous recommended-care set whose text already communicates recommendation.

variants.name: dont
variants.description: Error-family supporting icon treatment for a homogeneous discouraged-care set whose text already communicates prohibition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic component-width grid that adds or removes columns without a consumer viewport rule.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive document presentation with no selected, checked, acknowledged, dismissed, completed, focus, alert, validation, or workflow state.

behavior.name: semanticRoot
attributes: aria-labelledby only when the visible title is present
behavior.description: A visible title produces a named native section; without a title the composition uses a generic div and emits no dangling label relationship.

behavior.name: nonEmptyList
behavior.description: The required items slot supplies at least one record with stable key and non-empty label; otherwise the complete R4 root is omitted.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Targets render one native unordered list with direct native list items. The explicit matching role preserves list exposure where visual markers are removed.

behavior.name: textGuidance
behavior.description: Every instruction is complete in visible text; variant color, icon, layout, order, and hover never supply unique meaning.

behavior.name: decorativeIcon
behavior.description: Optional supporting icons are redundant with adjacent visible text and hidden from assistive technology. Target icon names are not neutral contract data.

behavior.name: homogeneousTone
behavior.description: Root variants provide supporting color for one homogeneous set and create no ARIA state. Legacy item modifiers remain compatibility hooks, not a public mixed-record API.

behavior.name: intrinsicResponsiveGrid
behavior.description: Canonical CSS derives column count from actual component width and wraps complete text without Studio- or consumer-owned responsive corrections.

behavior.name: passiveBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral R4 is not a checklist, choice list, alert, validation summary, task status, disclosure, acknowledgement, or workflow controller and owns no interactive role, tabindex, event, or keyboard model.

behavior.name: targetOwnedContent
behavior.description: Targets own product applicability, records, locale, revisions, editorial, safety and legal review, claims, recalls, standardized symbols, mappings, and lifecycle; the neutral contract defines only durable composition.

behavior.name: zeroRuntime
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no listener, observer, timer, request, state store, selection, acknowledgement, persistence, announcement, analytics, or target service.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional visible contextual heading; its presence selects named-section semantics.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned native unordered instruction composition with complete labels, optional details, and optional decorative icons; no product record schema is implied.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Neutral, recommended, or discouraged supporting icon treatment for one homogeneous set; visible target copy remains the source of meaning.

accessibility: Use a contextual visible heading when R4 should be a document section; title-absent compositions remain generic and emit no broken label reference.
Render one native unordered list with direct native list items and preserve list exposure when visual markers are removed.
Keep every instruction understandable through its required visible label and optional visible detail; do not rely on icon, green/red color, grid position, or item order.
Hide redundant decorative icons from assistive technology. Put any unique icon meaning into visible text instead of adding a duplicate accessible icon label.
Use Do or Don't only for a homogeneous set whose visible heading and item wording already communicate the recommendation or prohibition.
Allow long, localized and user-spaced text to wrap without truncation, clipping, overlap, or a consumer-owned viewport correction.
Do not add checkbox, option, alert, error, status, button, link, tabindex, selected/checked/acknowledged/completed state, roving focus, keyboard behavior, or live announcements to passive neutral R4.

web.notes: Conditional native section/div, unordered list/items, complete visible text, optional decorative icons, intrinsic canonical CSS, homogeneous supporting tone, and zero R4 JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Requires approved product data source, content authority, safety/legal review, section/block schema, limits/order, localization, symbol policy, and first template consumer.
